mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO friend_relation (id, user_low_id, user_high_id, initiator_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{userLowId}, #{userHighId}, #{initiatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_low_id, user_high_id, initiator_id, create_time FROM friend_relation WHERE user_low_id = #{userLowId} AND user_high_id = #{userHighId} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.user_id, a.nickname, a.password, a.avatar, a.create_time AS created_at FROM friend_relation fr INNER JOIN account a ON a.user_id = CASE WHEN fr.user_low_id = #{userId} THEN fr.user_high_id ELSE fr.user_low_id END WHERE fr.user_low_id = #{userId} OR fr.user_high_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.nickname ASC, a.user_id ASC
